Plot the simulated partial gamma DIF values

Source: R/dif_partgam.R
RMdifGammaPlot.Rd

Plots the simulated partial gamma of each item from RMdifGammaCutoff(), and optionally the observed values in your data, computed with the same routine as the simulations, which reproduces iarm::partgam_DIF().

Usage

RMdifGammaPlot(simfit, data, dif_var)

Arguments

simfit

The result of RMdifGammaCutoff().

data

Optional. The item responses the simulations were made from, items scored from 0. The observed partial gamma is then drawn as orange diamonds.

dif_var

Needed with data. The vector of groups used in RMdifGammaCutoff(), of length nrow(data).

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Each item's simulated values are drawn as dots, with the median, an inner 66% interval and an outer interval. The outer interval is the one in simfit$item_cutoffs, which RMdifGamma() tabulates: the HDCI of width hdci_width, or the 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles with cutoff_method = "quantile". The inner interval uses the same method. Without data the intervals are drawn with ggdist::stat_dotsinterval(). With data they are black segments with a black dot for the median, and the observed value is an orange diamond.

The intervals are per item and not corrected for testing several items. With the full cutoff object, RMdifGamma() flags items by adjusted p-values instead, so an item just outside its interval need not be flagged there. The plot shows no p-values.

The ggplot2 and ggdist packages must be installed (they are in Suggests).

See also

RMdifGammaCutoff(), RMdifGamma()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("ggdist", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(42)
  sim_data <- as.data.frame(
    matrix(sample(0:1, 200 * 10, replace = TRUE), nrow = 200, ncol = 10)
  )
  colnames(sim_data) <- paste0("Item", 1:10)
  dif_group <- factor(sample(c("A", "B"), 200, replace = TRUE))

  # Run the simulation
  cutoff_res <- RMdifGammaCutoff(sim_data, dif_var = dif_group,
                                 iterations = 100, parallel = FALSE,
                                 seed = 42)

  # Simulated distribution only
  RMdifGammaPlot(cutoff_res)

  # With observed partial gamma overlaid
  RMdifGammaPlot(cutoff_res, data = sim_data, dif_var = dif_group)
}

# }
